terminologyRules: Pneumonia is pulmonary parenchymal inflammation and is not synonymous with cough or upper respiratory disease.
An aspiration event, aspiration pneumonitis and secondary bacterial aspiration pneumonia are separate authored states.
Fever, CBC change or radiographic severity alone never proves bacterial etiology.
Respiratory stabilization and minimal handling precede radiography or airway sampling in an unstable patient.
Oropharyngeal or nasal swabs are not substitutes for a meaningful lower-airway sample.
Blood culture may support selected severe cases but is not presented as an equivalent replacement for lower-airway sampling.
Fungal and parasitic branches require compatible geography, species and exposure.
Clinical, hematologic and imaging recovery may occur at different rates and remain time-linked.
Oxygenation, imaging, culture truth, primary cause and response are authored before player choice and persist through reload.
Drug, dose, duration, oxygen target, sampling, intubation and ventilation technique require separately approved protocols.

commonHistoryQuestions.prompt: Когда начались cough/tachypnea/weakness и как менялись?
Какова измеренная RR во сне или полном покое?
Есть ли effort, cyanosis, collapse или syncope?
Были ли vomiting/regurgitation и когда относительно дыхательных признаков?
Были ли anesthesia, force-feeding или liquid medication?
Есть ли dysphagia, megaesophagus или cough with eating?
Каковы travel, region и environmental exposures?
Что получал пациент, когда и с каким ответом?
Как меняются appetite, activity и breathing?
Есть ли предыдущее thoracic image/report и дата?
Есть ли chronic airway disease, collapse, foreign-body risk или neoplasia?

variants.title: Бактериальная бронхопневмония
variants.diagnosticTruth: Clinical and thoracic evidence with meaningful lower-airway cytology/culture when feasible supports bacterial pulmonary infection and preserves its primary driver.

presentations.complaint: Cough, fever/systemic illness, tachypnea и compatible alveolar pattern.

examFindings.finding: Oxygen and handling threshold come first.

followUp.timing: early clinical response and authored culture/imaging checkpoint

outcomes.safe: Bacterial evidence and severity drive a reviewed plan.
outcomes.unsafe: Cough, fever or one CBC value generates an antimicrobial.

ownerCommunication: Explain what supports pneumonia and what is still needed to identify bacterial involvement.

presentations.complaint: После upper-airway/CIRDC-like illness появляются fever, systemic decline или lower-airway evidence.

followUp.timing: same-day severity route and early objective reassessment

outcomes.safe: Secondary infection is evidenced without discarding exposure control.
outcomes.unsafe: Shelter exposure automatically creates bacterial pneumonia.

ownerCommunication: Explain why worsening changes the workup but exposure alone does not prove bacteria.

presentations.complaint: Recurrent, unusually severe or poorly responsive pneumonia with immune/airway/source concern.

examFindings.finding: Immune, airway and aspiration drivers remain active.
Sample quality and diagnosis are audited.

followUp.timing: advanced source result and versioned response checkpoints

outcomes.safe: Recurrent disease leads to source control.

ownerCommunication: Explain why repeated episodes require finding the enabling disease.

variants.title: Аспирационный пневмонит или аспирационная пневмония
variants.diagnosticTruth: A timed aspiration event or ongoing source is linked to pulmonary disease while chemical injury and secondary bacterial infection retain separate evidence states.

presentations.complaint: После vomiting, regurgitation, anesthesia или feeding появились tachypnea/cough/lethargy.

followUp.timing: early breathing/oxygen reassessment and authored imaging evolution

outcomes.safe: Aspiration mechanism is linked while bacterial status remains evidenced.
outcomes.unsafe: Every event triggers the same antimicrobial plan.

ownerCommunication: Describe the event neutrally and explain how recurrence will be prevented.

presentations.complaint: Megaesophagus, dysphagia или laryngeal/pharyngeal dysfunction вызывает repeated aspiration.

outcomes.safe: Primary source and lung injury are managed together.
outcomes.unsafe: Discharge treats lungs but ignores feeding/swallow risk.

ownerCommunication: Explain how source control reduces recurrence without promising elimination.

presentations.complaint: Convincing event и new respiratory abnormality, но первый image normal/equivocal или changes evolve.

examFindings.finding: Clinical progression prompts support/reassessment, not automatic bacterial label.

followUp.timing: authored early reassessment; immediate if effort worsens

outcomes.safe: Timing limits are respected without automatic bacterial labeling.
outcomes.unsafe: One early image erases risk or waiting delays oxygen.

ownerCommunication: Explain why an early image may lag and what change requires immediate return.

variants.title: Тяжёлая гипоксемическая пневмония
variants.diagnosticTruth: Pulmonary disease causes dangerous oxygenation/ventilatory compromise or systemic sepsis requiring minimal handling, support and high-level care before complete etiologic workup.

presentations.complaint: Marked effort, cyanosis, mental change или reliable low oxygenation.

outcomes.safe: Gas exchange is protected before diagnostics.
outcomes.unsafe: Forced radiography or quietness is mistaken for stability.

ownerCommunication: Keep explanation brief: breathing support and transfer are the immediate priorities.

presentations.complaint: Perfusion abnormality, systemic illness и extensive/multilobar pulmonary pattern.

followUp.timing: continuous ICU plus authored culture callback

outcomes.safe: Sepsis support and culture proceed proportionately.
outcomes.unsafe: Perfect sample is required before emergency care or blood culture is overclaimed.

ownerCommunication: Explain critical systemic risk and why some diagnostics may be deferred or substituted.

presentations.complaint: Patient cannot maintain oxygenation off support or shows worsening fatigue/ventilatory failure.

outcomes.unsafe: Local care continues past capacity or UI invents ventilation settings.

ownerCommunication: Explain that advanced respiratory support is needed now, before complete exhaustion.

variants.title: Небактериальная пневмония или имитирующее заболевание
variants.diagnosticTruth: Pulmonary signs or imaging have a fungal, parasitic, protozoal, inflammatory or noninfectious explanation selected only by compatible species, geography, exposure and discriminator evidence.

presentations.complaint: Chronic/systemic or nodular/interstitial/alveolar pattern with compatible regional/environmental exposure.

outcomes.unsafe: Negative bacterial culture or random geography creates fungus.

ownerCommunication: Explain why travel/environment determines which uncommon tests have value.

presentations.complaint: Exposure/eosinophilia/airway pattern raises parasitic or inflammatory disease, but CBC alone is nondiagnostic.

outcomes.safe: Inflammatory and infectious causes are discriminated before reviewed treatment.
outcomes.unsafe: CBC alone labels disease or immunosuppression precedes infection screen.

ownerCommunication: Explain why one blood-cell pattern cannot identify the lung cause.

presentations.complaint: Edema, hemorrhage, neoplasia, trauma или other mimic competes with infectious pneumonia.

examFindings.finding: Cardiac, coagulation and oncology routes are explicit.
Evidence transfers case to correct family.

outcomes.safe: Dangerous alternative is diagnosed and transferred with history intact.
outcomes.unsafe: Repeated antimicrobials obscure edema, hemorrhage or mass.

ownerCommunication: Explain which noninfectious possibilities are dangerous and how the next test separates them.

variants.title: Контроль или неразрешающаяся пневмония
variants.diagnosticTruth: Clinical, hematologic and imaging trends are interpreted together; inadequate response triggers sample, assumption, adherence and source audit rather than random escalation.

presentations.complaint: Appetite/activity/effort improve; CBC and imaging may lag at different rates.

examFindings.finding: Reviewed stopping criteria remain external protocol.

outcomes.safe: Improvement is measured without demanding simultaneous normalization.
outcomes.unsafe: Treatment continues until a perfect image regardless of patient and protocol.

ownerCommunication: Explain which findings improve first and which red flags override the schedule.

presentations.complaint: Inadequate improvement, deterioration или susceptibility mismatch challenges the initial assumption.

historyAnswers.prior_treatment_response: Dose/duration/adherence/adverse effects recorded without code selecting them.

examFindings.finding: Resistance is one possibility, not the only one.

followUp.timing: prompt result/source audit and revised objective checkpoint

outcomes.safe: Failure is explained before a versioned plan changes.

ownerCommunication: Explain that nonresponse may reflect resistance, sample limits, adherence, source or wrong diagnosis.

presentations.complaint: Persistent focal/recurrent same-lobe lesion suggests foreign body, bronchiectasis, mass or primary airway disease.

outcomes.safe: Persistent focus receives source control with episode continuity.
outcomes.unsafe: Another empirical course or new random patient replaces due workup.

ownerCommunication: Explain why recurrence in the same location suggests a removable or structural source.

familyValidationRules: Reject if oxygen and minimal handling are delayed for radiography or sampling in respiratory distress.
Reject if cough, one CBC value or one radiographic pattern alone proves bacterial pneumonia.
Reject if every aspiration event is labeled bacterial infection.
Reject if nasal sampling is silently substituted for a lower-airway specimen or sample quality is discarded.
Reject if nonresolving disease only broadens treatment instead of reopening structural, fungal, parasitic and neoplastic mimics.
Reject if the generator creates an antimicrobial, drug, dose, oxygen target, ventilation setting or invasive sampling technique.
